faces: threads (read and write); sidebar and archived (read only, the same readers)
service: body, filtered by each face's manifest; no other service is called

session.list.params: {thread_id: null, include_archived: boolean, before: 32 hex | null, limit: 100}
session.list.reply: session page: {items: [session summary v2], next: 32 hex | null}; the node pages in its own order, so the face reads pages up to a bound and sorts by updated_at_ms

session.open.reply: {summary, entries: [session entry v2], next_sequence}; entries are contiguous from after_sequence + 1 and next_sequence is the last entry returned whenever another page exists; the face starts near the end and reads earlier pages on request

session.create.params: {thread_id: fresh 32 hex, title: first line of the first message, at most 256 bytes, mode}
session.create.reply: session summary v2; called only when the first message of a new chat is sent, never for an empty chat

chat.turn.params: {session_id, expected_sequence: last saved sequence, text: at most 32,768 bytes, mode}
chat.turn.reply: not read; the saved entries and the event topic are the record. A deadline is shown as unconfirmed, not as failed

model.cancel.params: {request_id, reservation_id} of the stream in flight
model.cancel.reply: not read; only the final receipt event settles the stream

session.event.value: an FD 4 event as {kind, body}, or with its envelope fields v (2), id and provenance; any other key breaks the shape
session.event.read: session.entry, session.append (its entry), session.create, model.start, model.delta, model.end, model.cancel, model.error, accepted, outcome, refusal
session.event.ignored: every other kind, including memory and health events; a read kind whose body breaks its shape is dropped and counted

records: v2 session summary, entry, model delta and receipt, read exactly as crates/canon fixes them: unknown keys, wrong types, stranger provenance and an owner or Auma role without its own provenance refuse the whole value
streams: model events carry no session id; a stream is shown in the chat of the turn this face sent, and in no other. A saved Auma entry replaces it, and its receipt is shown beside that entry
rendering: text only: fenced code blocks and inline code spans, no markup, links or images; hidden and bidi characters are shown as code points; a function-call suggestion is listed and never run; tool and context entries are labelled as data
sending: from the send button's click or Enter in the box; there is no form, because the frame is sandboxed without allow-forms
